history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with dark, styled hair is casually sitting on a wooden bench outdoors. He is wearing a dark blue short-sleeved collared shirt with a white patch on the left chest and a white rectangular patch with the text "OTSKY" on the right side of his chest. He is also wearing light-colored trousers and black dress shoes with white socks. The man is looking slightly to his right with a relaxed expression.

The background features a calm, dark green body of water, likely a lake or river, reflecting the lush, dense green foliage of a forest that covers a hillside behind the water. The trees are varied in shade, creating a rich texture of greens. The foreground consists of a grassy area with patches of dry grass, suggesting a natural, slightly unkempt environment. The lighting appears to be natural daylight, casting soft shadows and highlighting the textures of the scene. The overall mood is serene and peaceful, with a focus on the man's relaxed pose against the backdrop of nature. The color palette is dominated by various shades of green from the foliage and water, complemented by the neutral tones of the man's clothing and the earthy browns and greens of the ground. The image has a slightly desaturated, naturalistic photographic style.
